name: reconcile_declined
description: A provider-truth check whose gateway says every payment on this intent was refused. Distinct from PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION_PENDING in exactly one way that matters to the caller: a NEW intent is the recovery here, and polling is not. TOKEN-SHAPED (plan-09 §0.4): the live intent's pay_page_token is still re-served (the check never replaces an intent, only an explicit retry does), so the caller branches on the CODE, not on the presence of a handle - and no raw gateway handle crosses the wire.
